scope: Internal readonly reconnect evidence helper; private files and scripted MockBackend only. No real HID, product Apply, restore or quarantine resolution.
implementation: AwaitingReconnect record + matching canonical guard required; Unknown/NotStarted/Armed and serial-less targets cannot construct automatic probe.
Actual backend enumeration must first observe target serial absent; already attached or new path without absence is not fresh reconnect. Enumeration errors do not establish absence.
Unique same VID/PID/serial candidate only; fresh handle drains <=10 nonblocking reads then sends one cmd134, bounded shared collector, exact researched full1.6 token and optional PN1.
Recheck unchanged journal raw bytes and guard before query and after reply; close handle and re-enumerate same candidate before one-time evidence.
Guard read bypasses implicit state recovery and refuses pending settings/profile transactions without disk writes. Ordinary profile recovery also rejects guarded before/after snapshots.
Evidence has private operation ID, DeviceInfo and parsed identity; no clearing API or writable continuation token.

checks.native_gui: not run; no frontend/native app source change

coverage: Observed absence/reappearance, old and new hidraw paths, exact1.6 identity with/without optional date, stale pre-query input drain; single query/no replay/no clearing, handle drop.
Enumeration failure not considered detach; other serial and duplicate same-serial candidates never opened.
Open/write/read failure, noisy input, missing response, wrong version/model, disappearance during query and journal edit after query never yield evidence or restore.
Missing/mismatched settings guard and corrupt/deleted journal refuse before open.
Pending profile transaction cannot trigger implicit redo through probe; ordinary redo cannot remove guard, files preserved.
remaining: Global admission/job drain including cancellation-surviving workers/streams/monitors/reapers, manager discovery/replay and power transitions.
Coordinator must join old HID owner and exclude all writers before using probe in a joined blocking job; helper does not enforce this lifecycle alone.
Qualified durable resolution/restoration, serial-less identity recovery and missed fast-reset/restart policy.
Matching version token is not installed-image hash or hardware revision proof.
Staged Inspect/Apply/status/recovery product UI EN/RU, delivery and deferred hardware qualification.
